# Browser assets

Pinned, unmodified browser distributions from jsDelivr's npm mirror:

- `chart-4.4.3.min.js`: `chart.js@4.4.3/dist/chart.umd.min.js` (MIT).
- `chartjs-plugin-zoom-2.2.0.min.js`: `chartjs-plugin-zoom@2.2.0/dist/chartjs-plugin-zoom.min.js` (MIT).
- `hammer-2.0.8.min.js`: `hammerjs@2.0.8/hammer.min.js` (MIT).
- `icons/*.svg`: `lucide-static@0.468.0/icons/` (ISC; license includes upstream notices).

License files are included alongside these assets. Local copies keep chart rendering
independent of third-party CDN availability.

Zoom configuration and API: https://www.chartjs.org/chartjs-plugin-zoom/latest/guide/options.html
